messages:
Alex Chen: Quick sync — proposal: single mini-launch that ties a short tutorial, a tiny reference app demo, and a 30-min live benchmark walkthrough. Goal: drive dev signups + inbound leads from webinar.
Priya Singh: Love this. timeline?
Alex Chen: Target week of Apr 20 for the webinar, pre-launch posts the week before. 1 tutorial blog, 1 launch post, 1 short demo video (~3m).
Marco Rivera: Can we fold in a simple benchmark narrative? e.g., ‘latency/cost baseline: community model X vs. quantized Y on Redwood Dedicated’ — short slide and live run.
Casey Li: That works. I can prep a small benchmark script that runs a 50-request sweep with seq=512 and outputs p50/p95 + tokens/cost. Will need sample prompts.
Jenna Ortiz: I'll own comms: landing page copy, email invite, and social snippets. Can we agree on the main CTA? Webinar signup vs. immediate refapp download?
Alex Chen: CTA = webinar RSVP (collect email + company size). Post-webinar CTA points to the refapp repo + a ‘try Redwood hosted’ coupon.
Sam Park: Design: need 1 webinar hero, 1 GIF from the refapp demo, and a speaker slide. Can we lock assets by Apr 10?
Priya Singh: I'll write the tutorial draft (short, hands-on). Marco, can you add the benchmark commands I can paste?
Marco Rivera: Sure. Example run (to share in tutorial):
```
# run benchmark sweep
python bench.py --model open-x --quantize int8 --seq 512 --requests 50 --out results.json
cat results.json | jq '.summary | {p50, p95, tokens_per_sec, cost_per_1k}'
```
Use `--warmup 10` if you want stable numbers.
Casey Li: For lead routing: DevRel Bot will post new webinar RSVP to #marketing-leads and also trigger our HubSpot form via /webhook. Current mapping is: email -> lifecycle_stage:lead, utm_campaign -> source. Is that still ok?
DevRel Bot: automated note: demo-webinar-form posted to /integrations/hubspot/webhook (success).
Jenna Ortiz: Yes that's fine. Request: include a hidden field `signup_reason` with options (eval, pilot, POC, curious) so sales can prioritize.
Alex Chen: Good call. Also add `model_interest` checkbox (Hosted / Dedicated / Private).
Priya Singh: For the tutorial, I'll include a quick `config.yaml` snippet for onboarding:
```
api_key: REDWOOD_API_KEY
model: open-x@v1
max_tokens: 256
```
Keep it tiny so people can run in <10 minutes.
Sam Park: I'll make a GIF of the refapp showing streaming in ~7s. Where does the refapp live?
Marco Rivera: New repo: github.com/redwood-inference/community-mini-ref (private until launch). Will open on Apr 10.
Casey Li: Ops ask: for the live benchmark run on the webinar, we should have a fallback plan if Dedicated pool has issues. Suggest pre-recorded run as backup and a second lighter model as fallback.
Alex Chen: Agreed. Two backups: (1) pre-recorded video snippet, (2) switch to quantized variant `open-x-quant` which is compatible with hosted.
Jenna Ortiz: Promo cadence: announcement post (Apr 6), tutorial publish (Apr 10), webinar invite push (Apr 13), reminder day-before and morning-of. Social + short dev mailing.
Priya Singh: I'll need a review by Apr 8. Marco/Casy, can you review tutorial & benchmark notes by then?
Marco Rivera: I can do a technical review Apr 7.
Casey Li: Ops review Apr 8.
Sam Park: I'll deliver hero + GIF by Apr 9 for review.
Alex Chen: Action items: Priya = tutorial draft; Marco = benchmark script + open repo; Casey = lead routing confirm + fallback; Jenna = landing + emails; Sam = assets. We'll track in the marketing board under "mini-launch: community benchmark & tutorial".
Jenna Ortiz: I'll create the board card now and add owners.
DevRel Bot: reminder set: review meeting on Apr 11 10:00am PT -> invite sent to participants. :bell:
Alex Chen: Awesome. One more thing — messaging: focus on "ship reliable inference, faster" and a short example: "build a streaming chat in <10 lines". Keep it pragmatic.
Priya Singh: Noted. I'll draft 3 headline variants for A/B testing.
Marco Rivera: Also recommend a short benchmark snippet in the social post: `p50 85ms | cost 0.8¢/k token (quant)` — concrete numbers attract dev eyeballs.
Jenna Ortiz: Perfect. Thanks team — I'll post the initial promo copy once the landing is up.
Sam Park: +1 — will mock up the hero and GIF this afternoon.
Casey Li: Leaving a note: ensure GDPR consent on the form (checkbox).
Alex Chen: Good catch. Add to landing checklist.
DevRel Bot: meeting created: https://calendar.redwood.ai/event/mini-launch-review-3153604000
Jenna Ortiz: Closing loop — tagging @everyone in the card once assets are uploaded.
Alex Chen: Thanks all. Quick thumbs if you're good with plan. :thumbsup:
Priya Singh: :thumbsup:
Marco Rivera: :thumbsup:
Casey Li: :thumbsup:
Sam Park: :thumbsup:
Jenna Ortiz: :thumbsup:
DevRel Bot: thread archived for tracking.
